unspecified.behavior: A page request holds PYMUPDF_LOCK from opening the PDF until up to 4 pages are rendered and the document is closed, so an extraction that starts during that time waits for the whole request.

scores.reason: If someone asks about PDF pages while another PDF is being indexed, the indexing waits a few extra seconds, and the user notices nothing.

Confirmed at addons/intelligence/app/rag/file_question.py:1037-1063 (PageImages.open takes PYMUPDF_LOCK, and close releases it only after the document is closed). It shows up only when a PDF extraction or page OCR job starts while a page request renders its pages (at most 4 pages of up to 1280 px each, typically a second or two). The background indexing job is then delayed by that long, which the user does not notice.
